confound_control_preregistered.verdict: the within-system association (-0.1053) is STRONGER than the pooled one (-0.0908). Controlling for crystal system amplifies the effect by 16% rather than attenuating it, so the association is not symmetry difficulty masquerading as list length.

dissenting_systems.note: reported rather than pooled away; consistent with atom count proxying symmetry richness in those classes, which is the confound the pre-registration named

what_it_downgrades.new_status: UPPER BOUND on a symmetry-reasoning deficit, not a measurement of one; reported in the same paragraph as the median share

what_it_does_not_touch: the oracle-to-model gap is measured against pixels, not text; rung_R3_coords_as_text's direction is unaffected
limits: effect is small (0.042 across the median split); original sample only; 2 of 7 systems run positive
